newsitem.title: UK: UK skateboard maker Snakeboard to float on AIM.
newsitem.headline: UK skateboard maker Snakeboard to float on AIM.

text.p: Skateboard maker Snakeboard Plc is to float on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market later in November, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The prospectus and financial details of the issue will be released next week with dealings in the shares beginning the following week, although no firm date has been set. Dealings had provisionally been due to start today.

"Today was only one of various provisional dates and no definite date had been set," said the spokesman. Snakeboard was set up by two South African-born entrepreneurs, Oliver Macleod-Smith and James Fisher.

It produces and distributes snakeboards, a kind of skateboard with twin platforms, four wheels and a pivoting axle, and had sales of 2.2 million stg in the 10 months to March. The sponsor to the placing is Ellis and Partners.
